idea: A blank card lands on the page, three words drop onto it one per bar, and once they are swept away the card is given its name.
leave: A flip book is made of beats, frames and characters.
subject: the card, from blank to titled

device.what: every word and mark lands on a beat, with a drop sound where it hits
device.why: the words name the parts of a flip book, and landing on the beat shows them at work

change.from: one tilted edge of a card at the right side of the page
change.to: the card lies flat in the middle and a small ink ball bounces above it

change.from: the empty card with the bouncing ball
change.to: 一拍, 一帧 and 一个字 sit in a row on the card

change.from: three words in a row on the card
change.to: a red line runs under them and the words and ball fade off the card
翻页书 across the card with a red stamp at its lower right
